M1_physics_budget.verdict: THE 31x NUMBER WAS A MEASUREMENT-MODEL ARTIFACT: the 31 s is the whole falsifier-suite process (3 walk runs + a 426-tick push run + F-G5), misattributed to one 300-tick run. The honest steady-state CPU physics throughput of the pinned walk is ~43-44 ticks/s (~23 ms/tick), integration-dominated at 98.4%; serialization+diagnostics are ~1.6% and irrelevant. A 426-tick trial costs ~9.7 s, not 44 s. SHIPPING-BACKEND IMPLICATION: the exact CPU kernel is ~4.5x closer to interactive (6.8x vs 31x realtime gap) than the banked model; the P7 interactive budget (300 ticks/s for 1x realtime) still needs ~7x more throughput, which optimization or parallel worlds must supply -- but the gap is physics, not harness.
